en.topic_title: Tai Po fire: Housing Bureau to replace inspection unit criticised for multiple failings, ‘slack’ attitude
en.topic_summary:
The Housing Bureau will replace an independent inspection unit following heavy criticism over policy and operational failures and a “slack” work attitude in the lead-up to last year’s massive Tai Po fire.



Hong Kong top officials at a press conference on October 29, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee said on Thursday that a major shake-up will see the Housing Bureau’s Independent Checking Unit (ICU) replaced by a new regulatory body overseeing maintenance works a
